function.name: add_event
function.description: Add an event to the calendar

notes.description: Optional freeform notes for the event

function.name: list_inbox
function.description: List recent notifications/emails/chats in your inbox. Use this to see what notifications you've received.

function.name: update_event
function.description: Edit an existing calendar event. Identify it by id or by its current title (query), then change any of title, start/end time, or description.

query.description: Current title (or part of it) of the event to edit

startDate.description: New start date/time in ISO format

endDate.description: New end date/time in ISO format

notes.description: New freeform notes for the event

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Delete/remove a calendar event, identified by id or by its title (query).

query.description: Title (or part of it) of the event to delete

function.name: add_todo
function.description: Add a task with an optional due date, a checklist of items to do/answer, and reminders. Use reminder "persistent" when the user wants to be reminded until it's done (e.g. homework, bills).

dueDate.description: Optional due date/time in ISO format (local time)

reminder.description: persistent (keep reminding until done), normal (before the deadline), or off

items.description: Optional checklist: questions or steps, as strings

function.name: list_todos
function.description: List tasks, soonest deadline first, with overdue ones flagged, checklist progress and where they came from (Todoist, Notion, a course feed). By default only open tasks.

withinDays.description: Only tasks due within this many days (overdue always included)

function.name: complete_todo
function.description: Mark a todo as done (or reopen it), identified by id or by its title (query).

query.description: Title (or part of it) of the todo

done.description: true to mark done (default), false to reopen it

function.name: update_todo
function.description: Edit an existing todo. Identify it by id or by its current title (query), then change title, priority, or due date.

query.description: Current title (or part of it) of the todo to edit

priority.description: New priority: low, medium, or high

dueDate.description: New due date in ISO format

function.name: delete_todo
function.description: Delete/remove a todo, identified by id or by its title (query).

query.description: Title (or part of it) of the todo to delete

function.name: add_note
function.description: Create a note in the note-taking app. Use for anything the user wants to jot down, save, or remember as free text (ideas, lists, meeting notes, thoughts) — as opposed to a dated task (add_todo) or a scheduled event (add_event).

pinned.description: Pin the note to the top

function.name: list_notes
function.description: List saved notes (output includes each note's id). Optionally filter by a search query matching title, body, or tags.

query.description: Optional text to filter notes by

function.name: update_note
function.description: Edit an existing note. Identify it by id or by its current title (query), then change title, body, tags, or pin.

query.description: Current title (or part of it) of the note to edit

body.description: New body text (replaces the existing body)

function.name: remember_entity
function.description: Store an entity in your knowledge graph. Use this when the user tells you something important about a person, place, concept, or thing that they might want you to recall later.

type.description: Entity type (person, place, concept, project, preference, etc.)

description.description: What to remember about this entity

function.name: recall_memory
function.description: Search your knowledge graph. Call this when the user asks about something they told you earlier, or when you need context from prior conversations.

query.description: What to search for in the knowledge graph
